mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing the present value of future cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 2.5% annualized inflation rate signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain restrictive monetary policy, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL annualized inflation rate > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a tight labor market with aggressive monetary tightening, which increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with monetary tightening
failure_condition: The joint condition of FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling does not produce negative 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), the labor market tightness accelerates corporate hiring and wage growth, boosting near-term earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, which supports corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances when HOUST is rising, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 (index) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 110.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of rising HOUST and rising RSAFS does not produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression has a p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a high GDP growth regime (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized), the economy is expanding rapidly, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in < 40% of instances when GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
